page.notes: Line "exscripta fint,quique": the first letter of "sint" is printed like an f; read as s, marked [?]. "sieri" and "fensum" read as printed with long s rendered as s; "loci fensum" was set with a space, rendered "loci sensum". The catchword "ejuf-" is at the lower right and the signature "A 4" at the foot. No marginal notes on this page.
